name: Ehi
title: Son of Benjamin
summary: Ehi was one of the sons of Benjamin, Jacob's youngest son. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 46:21 among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob. He is considered one of the founders of one of Benjamin's clans.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Ehi is listed as one of Benjamin's ten sons in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Ehi was among the 70 members of Jacob's family who went down to Egypt to settle in Goshen during the famine.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Gathered in Egypt
keyEvents.description: Joseph invited his entire father's household to Egypt, and Ehi was among those received by Pharaoh and allowed to live in the best part of the land.

keyEvents.title: Possible Identification with Ahiram
keyEvents.description: In Numbers 4:26, Benjamin's descendants are listed in the census, where Ahiram is likely the same person as Ehi, and the Ahiramites are mentioned as a clan.
